Order 
This second application under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant for grant of regular bail in relation to FIR No.407/2021 dated 25.08.2021 registered at Police Station-Parwati,
District-Sehore (M.P.) for commission of offence under Section 363, 366, 506, 376(3)/34 of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.

Applicant is in detention since 14.04.2024.
2.

376(3)/34 of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.

sentences.text: that one more opportunity may be given to him to remain on bail.
4 . On the other hand, learned counsel for the State as well as learned counsel for the objector/victim have opposed grant of bail to the applicant.
5 . It is a case of bail jump and applicant is in detention since 14.04.2024.
It appears that he has learnt sufficient lesson for his absence from the trial Court.

Considering the detention period of the applicant, I am of the view that it would be just and proper to give applicant one more opportunity to remain on bail as he has learnt sufficient lesson for his absence from the trial Court.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant - Abhishek Mewada be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with a surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it till the final outcome of case.
He shall not seek any adjournments whenever witnesses are in attendance.

He shall abide by all the conditions NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:45998 3 MCRC-37795-2024 enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
Learned trial Court shall be at liberty to proceed under Section 446 of Cr.P.C. against applicant and his surety to levy the penalty.
8 . This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
